description: This file is a shell script that configures GRE tunnels, bridge interfaces, and sets up system and network configurations related to hotspot and GRE tunnel management.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events related to snooper logs by enabling relevant circuits and remote features.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from PSM database and initializes variables for GRE tunnel setup.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates and configures GRE tunnel interfaces, bridge interfaces, and vconfig settings for tunnel operation.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Sets system events for keep-alive configurations and hotspot primary/secondary endpoints.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for network forwarding and filtering related to the hotspot GRE tunnel.

calls: ip link add gretap0 type gretap remote `sysevent get hotspotfd-tunnelEP` local ...
